personality.description: This person tends to keep a fairly steady routine but will try new approaches when they seem useful, and they usually prefer having a clear plan without becoming rigid about it. They are comfortable alternating between social interaction and time alone, though stress can make them withdraw and replay concerns in their mind. In moral dilemmas, they are likely to scrutinize others’ intentions, weigh how each option affects their own goals, and choose the path that feels least risky or least costly to them. In group discussions, they speak in a measured way, do not overshare easily, and may sound guarded or skeptical, but they will contribute more when they see a practical reason to engage.
